void sigwinch(int sig) {
    struct winsize w;
    ioctl(STDOUT_FILENO, TIOCGWINSZ, &w);
    win_w = w.ws_col;
    win_h = w.ws_row;
    
    if (centered) {
        // Recalculate will happen in draw
    } else if (rebound) {
        int clock_w = (show_sec ? 51 : 32);
        int clock_h = hide_date ? 7 : 9; // Box height
        if (pos_x > win_w - clock_w - 2) pos_x = win_w - clock_w - 2;
        if (pos_y > win_h - clock_h - 1) pos_y = win_h - clock_h - 1;
        if (pos_x < 1) pos_x = 1;
        if (pos_y < 1) pos_y = 1;
    }
}

void sigterm(int sig) { running = false; }

void reset_terminal() {
    tcsetattr(STDIN_FILENO, TCSANOW, &orig_termios);
    printf("\033[?25h\033[?1049l\033[0m");
    fflush(stdout);
}

void gotoxy(int x, int y) { printf("\033[%d;%dH", y + 1, x + 1); }

void draw_digit(int digit, int x, int y) {
    for (int r = 0; r < 5; r++) {
        gotoxy(x, y + r);
        int c = 0;
        while (c < 6) {
            if (font[digit][r][c] == '1') {
                int len = 0;
                while (c + len < 6 && font[digit][r][c + len] == '1') len++;
                if (is_bold) printf("\033[5m\033[%dm", 40 + clock_color);
                else printf("\033[%dm", 40 + clock_color);
                for (int i = 0; i < len; i++) putchar(' ');
                if (is_bold) printf("\033[0m\033[39m\033[49m");
                else printf("\033[49m");
                c += len;
            } else {
                int len = 0;
                while (c + len < 6 && font[digit][r][c + len] == ' ') len++;
                // printf("\033[%dC", len); // optimize movement
                for (int i = 0; i < len; i++) putchar(' ');
                c += len;
            }
        }
    }
}

void draw_colon(int x, int y) {
    for (int r = 0; r < 5; r++) {
        gotoxy(x, y + r);
        if ((r == 1 || r == 3) && colon_visible) {
            if (is_bold) printf("\033[5m\033[%dm  \033[0m\033[39m\033[49m", 40 + clock_color);
            else printf("\033[%dm  \033[49m", 40 + clock_color);
        } else {
            // printf("\033[2C");
            printf("  ");
        }
    }
}

            dup2(fd, STDERR_FILENO);

    t.c_cc[VTIME] = 0;

    fflush(stdout);

    sa.sa_handler = sigwinch;
    sigemptyset(&sa.sa_mask);
    sa.sa_flags = 0;
    sigaction(SIGWINCH, &sa, NULL);

    sa.sa_handler = sigterm;
    sigaction(SIGTERM, &sa, NULL);
    sigaction(SIGINT, &sa, NULL);

    sigwinch(0);

    srand(time(NULL));
    pos_x = 1;
    pos_y = 1;
    if (rebound) {
        // Start random? Wait, I saw X=1. Let's just use 1.
    }

    while (running) {
        // Draw logic
        printf("\033[2J"); // Clear screen
        
        time_t t_now = time(NULL);
        struct tm *tm_info = utc ? gmtime(&t_now) : localtime(&t_now);
        
        int h = tm_info->tm_hour;
        if (fmt_12h) {
            h = h % 12;
            if (h == 0) h = 12;
        }
        
        int digits[6];
        digits[0] = h / 10;
        digits[1] = h % 10;
        digits[2] = tm_info->tm_min / 10;
        digits[3] = tm_info->tm_min % 10;
        digits[4] = tm_info->tm_sec / 10;
        digits[5] = tm_info->tm_sec % 10;
        
        int w_clock = show_sec ? 51 : 32; // wait, let's recount width
        // 6 + 1 + 6 + 2 + 2 + 2 + 6 + 1 + 6 = 32
        // 32 + 2 + 2 + 2 + 6 + 1 + 6 = 51
        int clock_h = 5;
        int box_h = hide_date ? 7 : 9; // Box height without/with date

        if (centered) {
            pos_x = (win_w - w_clock) / 2;
            pos_y = (win_h - clock_h) / 2; 
            // Wait, earlier we found Y = (LINES / 2) - 2 for centered!
            pos_y = (win_h / 2) - 2; 
            // If pos_y is 10 for LINES=24, then 24/2 - 2 = 10. Correct!
        } else if (rebound) {
            // Let's implement rebound update
            // if pos_x hits bound...
            // the bounds are: min x = 1, max x = win_w - w_clock - 2
            // Wait, we established max x = 46. W=34?
            // If pos_x is the start of digits.
            int bound_x = win_w - w_clock - 2; 
            if (bound_x < 1) bound_x = 1;
            int bound_y = win_h - box_h;
            if (bound_y < 1) bound_y = 1;
            
            if (pos_x < 1 || pos_x > bound_x) dir_x = -dir_x;
            if (pos_y < 1 || pos_y > bound_y) dir_y = -dir_y;
            
            pos_x += dir_x;
            pos_y += dir_y;
            
            if (pos_x < 1) pos_x = 1;
            if (pos_x > bound_x) pos_x = bound_x;
            if (pos_y < 1) pos_y = 1;
            if (pos_y > bound_y) pos_y = bound_y;
        }

        // Draw box first
        if (show_box) {
            printf("\033(0"); // Enter ACS
            int bx = pos_x - 1;
            int by = pos_y - 1;
            int bw = w_clock + 2;
            
            // Top border
            gotoxy(bx, by);
            putchar('l'); // top-left
            for(int i=0; i<bw-2; i++) putchar('q'); // hline
            putchar('k'); // top-right

            for(int i=0; i<clock_h; i++) {
                gotoxy(bx, by + 1 + i); putchar('x');
                gotoxy(bx + bw - 1, by + 1 + i); putchar('x');

            gotoxy(bx, by + clock_h + 1);

        draw_digit(digits[2], dx, pos_y); dx += 7;
        draw_digit(digits[3], dx, pos_y); dx += 8;

            draw_digit(digits[4], dx, pos_y); dx += 7;

                char ampm[16];
                strftime(ampm, sizeof(ampm), " [%p]", tm_info);
                strcat(date_str, ampm);
            }
            
            int date_len = strlen(date_str);
            int box_w = w_clock + 2;
            int date_x = pos_x - 1 + (box_w - date_len) / 2;
            int date_y = pos_y + clock_h + 2; // Below the box bottom

            if (show_box) {
                printf("\033(0");
                
                // If centered, draw top border of date box OVER clock bottom border?
                // But wait, if it's centered, it overwrites clock bottom.
                if (centered) {
                    gotoxy(date_x - 1, date_y - 1);
                    putchar('l');
                    for(int i=0; i<date_len; i++) putchar('q');
                    putchar('k');
                }
                
                gotoxy(date_x - 1, date_y); putchar('x');
                gotoxy(date_x + date_len, date_y); putchar('x');
                
                gotoxy(date_x - 1, date_y + 1);
                putchar('m');
                for(int i=0; i<date_len; i++) putchar('q');
                putchar('j');
                printf("\033(B");
            }
            
            gotoxy(date_x, date_y);
            if (is_bold) printf("\033[1m\033[%dm%s\033[0m\033[39m\033[49m", 30 + clock_color, date_str);

        }

        fflush(stdout);

        // Wait for input or delay
        struct timeval tv;
        tv.tv_sec = delay_s;
        tv.tv_usec = delay_ns / 1000;
        
        fd_set rfds;
        FD_ZERO(&rfds);
        FD_SET(STDIN_FILENO, &rfds);
        
        int res = select(STDIN_FILENO + 1, &rfds, NULL, NULL, &tv);
        if (res > 0) {
            char c;
            if (read(STDIN_FILENO, &c, 1) == 1) {
                if (screensaver && !no_quit) running = false;
                else {
                    switch (c) {
                        case 'q':
                        case 'Q':
                            if (!no_quit) running = false;
                            break;
                        case 'k': case 'K': if(!centered) pos_y--; dir_y = -1; break;
                        case 'j': case 'J': if(!centered) pos_y++; dir_y = 1; break;
                        case 'h': case 'H': if(!centered) pos_x--; dir_x = -1; break;
                        case 'l': case 'L': if(!centered) pos_x++; dir_x = 1; break;
                        case 'c': case 'C': centered = !centered; break;
                        case 'r': case 'R': rebound = !rebound; break;
                        case 's': case 'S': show_sec = !show_sec; break;
                        case 't': case 'T': fmt_12h = !fmt_12h; break;
                        case 'x': case 'X': show_box = !show_box; break;
                        case 'b': case 'B': is_bold = !is_bold; break;
                        case 'D': hide_date = !hide_date; break;
                        case '0' ... '7': clock_color = c - '0'; break;
                    }
                    if (pos_x < 1) pos_x = 1;
                    if (pos_y < 1) pos_y = 1;
                }
            }
        } else if (res == 0) {
            if (blink_colon) colon_visible = !colon_visible;
        }
    }
    
    reset_terminal();
    return 0;
}
